description: AGGREGATION POLICY on tables: zero-arg/AGGREGATION_CONSTRAINT-return signature rules, body-only AGGREGATION_CONSTRAINT(), SHOW/DESCRIBE shape, one-policy-per-table (FORCE to replace), aggregation-required refusals, small groups folded into a NULL-keyed remainder (GROUP BY and DISTINCT, ENTITY KEY counting distinct entities), the leak-prone aggregates refused while STDDEV passes (measured), inner selects unjudged, GET_DDL rendering the attachment, attached policies undroppable, WITH AGGREGATION POLICY at CREATE, and the keywords staying ordinary names. Converted 1:1 from ddl/AggregationPolicyTest (now retired).
